audience: support and documentation teams who write their knowledge base in KnowledgeOwl

useCases.title: List articles and the category tree of a knowledge base
useCases.text: The AI lists the articles of a knowledge base and its categories (the table of contents). You get an overview of what content exists and where it sits.

useCases.title: Read what readers say about your articles
useCases.text: The AI reads reader comments and feedback on articles and sums up common complaints and questions.

useCases.title: See what readers search for
useCases.text: The AI reads search suggestions (reader search analytics) and the search synonyms you set. It shows topics readers look for that may need new content.

useCases.title: Check the version and revision history of an article
useCases.text: The AI reads the article versions and the revision history (audit trail) for your articles, so you can see what changed.

useCases.title: Draft a new article or update an existing one
useCases.text: The AI creates an article with name, status, visibility and its title and body, or changes fields of an existing article.

useCases.title: Add a category, snippet or glossary term
useCases.text: The AI creates a category, a reusable snippet or a glossary term with its definition.
